自治体は、寄付総額を伸ばすだけでなく、返礼品カテゴリと事業者の組み合わせを最適化: Municipalities want not only to grow total donation amounts, but also to optimize the combination of return-gift categories and suppliers, cultivate repeat donors, and strengthen the local supply chain. However, data is siloed by department, and the same terms — "municipality," "return gift," and "supplier" — are used with different definitions across teams and tools.

Master and historical data (batch) together with daily increments (operational observation) need to be handled in the same business language, yet without mixing grains. This hands-on workshop builds that state using Microsoft Fabric's Lakehouse, Eventhouse, Ontology, and Data Agent.

これらはすべて「クエリが書けるか」ではなく「意味が宣言されているか」の問題です。: All of these are questions of "is the meaning declared" rather than "can a query be written." This guide focuses not on how to write SQL, but on how to declare business meaning as a model.

2. DBA・BI エンジニアのための思考の切り替え: 2. Mindset Shift for DBA and BI Engineers
RDB とセマンティックモデルの経験は Ontology 設計でそのまま活きます: Experience with RDB and semantic models carries over directly to Ontology design — but the purpose differs. RDB exists to "store data correctly"; a BI semantic model exists to "aggregate quickly and correctly"; an Ontology exists to "declare business meaning so that both humans and agents can navigate with the same understanding."
RDB・BI セマンティックモデル・Ontology の役割の違い。三者は置き換: Differences in the roles of RDB, BI semantic model, and Ontology. The three are not replacements for one another but rather a layered stack.
3 列の比較図。左列は RDB で、テーブル、主キー、外部キー、正規化、整合性を: A three-column comparison diagram. The left column shows RDB: tables, primary key, foreign key, normalization, and integrity. The center column shows BI semantic model: fact, dimension, measure, star schema, and filter propagation. The right column shows Ontology: Entity Type, Property, Relationship Type, business graph, and declaration of meaning and boundary. A band at the bottom indicates that the three are a layered stack, not replacements for one another.
データを正しく保存・更新し、整合性を守ること: To store and update data correctly and maintain integrity
集計・フィルター・レポートを高速かつ一貫して行うこと: To perform aggregation, filtering, and reporting quickly and consistently
業務上の意味・同一性・たどれる関係を宣言すること: To declare business meaning, identity, and traversable relationships
ビジネスグラフ（概念と関係の明示）: Business graph (explicit declaration of concepts and relationships)
JOIN は実装手段。どの列で結べるかを表す: JOIN is an implementation mechanism — it indicates which columns can be joined.
Relationship は「何を主張し、何を主張しないか」を表す: Relationship states "what is claimed and what is not claimed."
レポート作者の合意とドキュメントで吸収する: Absorbed by report-author consensus and documentation
同義語・説明・境界としてモデルに埋め込む: Embedded in the model as synonyms, descriptions, and boundaries
人・レポート・エージェントの三者が同じ定義を共有する: Humans, reports, and agents all share the same definition
2.1 「JOIN できる」と「関係が意味を持つ」は違う: 2.1 "Can be JOINed" and "relationship carries meaning" are different
RDB では、列の型と値が合えば JOIN できます。BI では、リレーションシ: In RDB, if column types and values match, a JOIN can be done. In BI, drawing a relationship propagates a filter. But an Ontology Relationship declares "is this assertion valid from a business standpoint?" For example, Supplier and Gift can be connected, but the relationship means catalog registration — not shipment, and not revenue attribution. Whether you can declare this "what is not proven" determines the accuracy of agent responses.
外部キー・フィルター方向・Relationship 方向の違い: Differences between foreign key, filter direction, and Relationship direction
参照整合性の制約。「この値は親表に存在する」だけを保証する。: A referential integrity constraint. It guarantees only that "this value exists in the parent table."
向きは制約の向きであり、業務上の意味は持たない。: The direction is the direction of the constraint and carries no business meaning.
フィルターがどちらへ伝播するかという計算上の設定。: A computational setting specifying which direction a filter propagates.
単方向 / 双方向はレポートの都合であり、業務の主張ではない。: Single-direction / bidirectional is a reporting convenience, not a business assertion.
「誰が何に対して何をしたか」という業務上の主張。: A business assertion stating "who did what to whom."
逆方向トラバースは可能だが、宣言された向きは保持される。: Reverse traversal is possible, but the declared direction is preserved.
1 側と多側の業務的な制約。データ品質の期待値でもある。: A business constraint on the one side and many side. Also serves as a data-quality expected value.
「1 自治体は必ず 1 都道府県に属する」は業務ルールとして宣言する。: "One municipality must belong to exactly one prefecture" is declared as a business rule.
その関係が「証明しないこと」。エージェントの飛躍を止める。: What the relationship does "not prove." This prevents the agent from making unwarranted leaps.
SupplierProvidesGift はカタログ登録であり、発送も売上配賦も: SupplierProvidesGift is catalog registration and proves neither shipment nor revenue attribution.
RDB・BI からの移行でつまずきやすい点: Common pitfalls when migrating from RDB or BI
テーブルの数だけ Entity を作ればよい: One Entity per table is sufficient
業務上の主語にならないテーブルは Entity にしない: Tables that are not business subjects should not become Entities
第 3 章のパターン表で分類してから作る: Classify using the pattern table in Chapter 3 before creating
外部キーはすべて Relationship にする: All foreign keys should become Relationships
意味のない経路はノイズになり、誤った多段推論を招く: Meaningless paths become noise and lead to incorrect multi-hop reasoning
業務的に意味のある経路だけを選ぶ: Select only paths that carry business meaning
集計はすべて明細から計算すればよい: All aggregations can be computed from detail records
複合粒度は二重集計の温床になる: Mixed grains are a breeding ground for double-counting
複合粒度のみメトリック Entity として独立させる: Isolate mixed-grain data only as metric Entities
同義語や説明は後から足せばよい: Synonyms and descriptions can be added later
曖昧語の解決はモデルの一部であり、回答精度に直結する: Resolving ambiguous terms is part of the model and directly affects answer accuracy
設計時に境界と同義語を宣言する: Declare boundaries and synonyms at design time
リアルタイムのイベントも明細に入れればよい: Real-time events can simply be added to the detail records
粒度が違うデータを混ぜると件数が意味を失う: Mixing data of different grains causes record counts to lose meaning
3. RDB から Ontology への設計手順: 3. Design Procedure from RDB to Ontology
この章は、既存の RDB やセマンティックモデルを持っている読者が、自分のドメイ: This chapter is a procedure for readers who have an existing RDB or semantic model and want to design an Ontology for their own domain. It is written not as a mapping table to fill in and be done, but as a decision procedure that answers "on what basis, and which do you choose?"
ビジネス上の問いと意思決定から始める。テーブル一覧から始めない。: Start from business questions and decisions. Do not start from a table list.
候補となる概念ごとに粒度（1 行が何を表すか）を 1 文で書き出す。: Write out the grain (what one row represents) for each candidate concept in one sentence.
安定した業務識別子と、表示用ラベルを分離する。: Separate the stable business identifier from the display label.
エンティティの境界を決める（どこまでが同じ概念か）。: Determine the entity boundary (how far the same concept extends).
属性にするか、独立したエンティティにするかを判断する。: Decide whether something is an attribute or an independent entity.
業務的に意味のある外部キー経路だけを Relationship に変換する。: Convert only foreign-key paths that carry business meaning into Relationships.
Relationship の方向・カーディナリティ・否定的意味を宣言する。: Declare the direction, cardinality, and negative meaning of each Relationship.
複合粒度の事前集計はメトリック / フロー Entity として切り出す。: Extract pre-aggregations at mixed grains as metric / flow Entities.
時刻付き観測は time-series バインディングか、イベント Entity: Choose between time-series binding or an event Entity for timestamped observations.
